title: Money secrets: How does trade secret legal protection affect firm market value? Evidence from the uniform trade secret act

rival_explanations: industry patent intensity confound (the mobility interaction may capture an interaction between trade secret protection and industry propensity to patent)

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (private equity buyouts of U.S. private firms spanning 61 SIC two-digit industries; ~41% in manufacturing)
context.sample_description: U.S. private firms bought and resold by private equity (PE) firms; data assembled from PE fundraising prospectuses / private placement memoranda (PPM), complemented with COMPUSTAT and the NBER patent database; excluded firms with missing key information or unconfirmed locations and target firms located outside the United States

data_sources.name: private placement memoranda (PPM) / PE fundraising prospectuses
Bessen (2009) concordance file (patent assignee to COMPUSTAT GVKEY)
state economic and political conditions (GDP per capita, number of firms, governor party affiliation)
